findings.title: Missing Required Verification Evidence
findings.description: The implementation plan (Phase 5) and original user requirements explicitly mandate running the application, capturing screenshots, comparing against reference screenshots, testing workflows, and checking console errors. No verification evidence was found.
findings.consequence: Cannot confirm that: (1) application compiles without errors, (2) visual changes match reference screenshots (source of truth), (3) RTL layout renders correctly, (4) animations work without breaking functionality, (5) hover states are visible and subtle as specified.
findings.correction: Before approval: (1) Run npm run dev and npm run electron:dev, (2) Capture screenshots of main dashboard, upload modal, category modal with emoji picker, populated document list, hover states, empty states, (3) Compare screenshots against original reference images, (4) Run basic workflows (create category, upload fax, add document) and confirm no console errors, (5) Record results in REFACTOR_COMPLETE.md with visual validation section.

findings.title: fax.css Contains 40+ Hardcoded Colors
findings.description: The file contains 40+ instances of hardcoded color values (#ffffff, #e8eaed, #1a202c, #64748b, #f8f9fb, etc.) instead of using design tokens. The plan states fax.css was 'Already Refactored (Complete)' but inspection reveals it was not refactored. Examples: background: #ffffff (should be var(--bg-surface)), border: 1px solid #e8eaed (should be var(--border-color)), color: #1a202c (should be var(--text-primary)), and linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%) violates Modern Minimalist principle.
findings.consequence: Visual inconsistency if design tokens are updated, fax.css components won't match the rest of the application, maintenance burden requiring dual updates, violates the design system established in design-tokens.css.
findings.correction: Systematically replace all hardcoded colors in fax.css with design tokens: #ffffff → var(--bg-surface), #e8eaed/#E2E7EE → var(--border-color), #1a202c/#202938 → var(--text-primary), #64748b/#718096 → var(--text-secondary), #f8f9fb/#F7F8FA → var(--bg-app) or var(--bg-hover), remove gradients: linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%) → solid var(--color-primary). Review ALL color instances including shadows, borders, backgrounds, and text across all selectors.

findings.title: Duplicate Styles Between layout.css and files.css
findings.description: Both files define identical or near-identical styles for: .sidebar, .sidebar-header, .sidebar-content, .file-item, .file-checkbox, .file-action-btn, .empty-sidebar, .date-filter-container, .search-filter-container, .selection-toolbar. This violates DRY principle and contradicts plan Task 3.1 requirement to consolidate.
findings.consequence: Maintenance nightmare: changes must be duplicated, risk of divergence: one file updated other forgotten, increased CSS bundle size, violates plan requirement 'Avoid duplicating styles and creating conflicting CSS rules'.
findings.correction: Execute plan Task 3.1: (1) Remove all layout-related duplicates from files.css, (2) Keep only file-specific styles in files.css (thumbnail rendering, loading states, placeholders), (3) Verify no visual regression by testing 'Today's Files' sidebar after consolidation.

findings.title: Incomplete Verification - Emoji Picker Gradient Removal
findings.description: The plan (Task 2.3) specifies removing gradients from emoji picker category buttons. The commit message claims 'simplified category buttons (removed gradient)' but current file shows no gradient in active state (uses solid var(--color-primary)). Cannot verify via static analysis whether gradient was actually removed in this commit or earlier. This is a documentation/verification issue rather than code defect.
findings.consequence: Incomplete audit trail, potential confusion in code review, cannot confirm visual compliance without seeing running application.
findings.correction: Provide verification evidence: (1) Run git diff 3fa30ea..40e3880 src/styles/emoji.css to verify whether gradient was actually removed in commit 40e3880, (2) If gradient removal happened in earlier commit, clarify in documentation, (3) Provide screenshot of emoji picker category buttons in running application to confirm solid colors (not gradients) are used.
